meta_description:
313 likes, 5 comments - khanacademy on September 23, 2026: "How do you investigate something the size of a Parade balloon? Start small. 🎈

In this free, hands-on STEAM activity, students use balloon models to explore balanced forces, then apply what they learn to explain how giant balloons stay in place and design a Parade balloon of their own. Free teacher and student guides are included.

Explore the activity 🔗Link in bio! 

Then let their ideas take flight. Teachers and families can share finished student artwork, with permission, using #MacysParade.

Created by Khan Academy with support from Macy’s in celebration of the 100th Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade®.".
